hypotheses.M0_shapley_recomposition_is_exact: Residual response plus four exact MLP-layer Shapley vectors reconstructs the all-MLP response to maximum absolute error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.M1_one_mlp_layer_dominates: At least one layer receives at least 50 percent target projection on every corpus.
hypotheses.M2_late_mlp_layers_dominate: Layers 9 and 10 together receive at least 70 percent target projection on every corpus.
hypotheses.M3_progressive_unfreezing_is_monotonic: Cumulative chronological unfreezing never lowers response fidelity by more than 0.02 on any corpus.
hypotheses.M4_mlp_layer_interactions_are_material: The difference between the all-dynamic response and the additive sum of four single-layer responses has norm at least 10 percent of the target on every corpus.
hypotheses.M5_layer_profile_transfers_ood: Every OOD Shapley projection differs from FineWeb by at most 0.10 for each layer.
hypotheses.M6_early_late_cancellation_is_material: The sum of absolute MLP-layer target projections is at least 1.20 on every corpus.
